solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Number having necessary skill and power to be defended

parts.note: ten is a number
ability is the skill needed to do something

explanation.surface: Someone numbered among the competent and powerful is worth defending.
explanation.definitionFit: Tenability is the quality of a position that can be held or maintained against attack.

clue.text: Note I would be in season

indicators.note: the words 'I would' are to be placed inside the note

parts.note: te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale
I'd is the contraction of I would

explanation.surface: A musician says a certain note would suit a particular season.
explanation.definitionFit: Tide is an old word for a season or festival time, surviving in Yuletide and Eastertide.

clue.text: Greek character had lines that were void

parts.note: nu is a letter of the Greek alphabet
L is an abbreviation for line, so LL is lines

explanation.surface: A Greek letter's lines were declared invalid.
explanation.definitionFit: Null and void are paired legal synonyms meaning having no force or validity.

clue.text: Sound performers were outlawed

indicators.note: the clue's opening word asks for a word that is said like another

parts.note: a band is a group of musical performers

explanation.surface: Musicians making noise found themselves prohibited.
explanation.definitionFit: To be banned is to be prohibited by law or rule, the same as being outlawed.

clue.text: Amusing way to maximise the pounds

definitions.text: Amusing way to maximise the pounds

parts.words: Amusing way to maximise the pounds
parts.note: pounds look like money but are body weight: an old proverb says cheerfulness makes you plump

explanation.surface: A jolly scheme for getting rich.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb holds that a merry person thrives and puts on weight, so good humour adds pounds.

clue.text: Preserve type of loaf first in container

indicators.note: the loaf comes before the other piece

parts.note: a tin is a loaf baked in a rectangular tin
to can food is to preserve it

explanation.surface: Advice on how to keep a loaf fresh by putting it into a box.
explanation.definitionFit: A tin can is a metal container for food or drink.

clue.text: Priest entered a southeastern part of church

indicators.note: the priest goes into the other letters, as a person enters a room

parts.note: SE is the compass abbreviation for southeast

explanation.surface: A clergyman walked into the southeastern section of a church.
explanation.definitionFit: An apse is the semicircular recess, often at the east end, of a church.

clue.text: Indicate unfilled space is very close

parts.note: to point is to indicate
a blank is a space left empty on a form

explanation.surface: Pointing to an empty space when something is near at hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Point-blank range means extremely close, so close the shot needs no aim.

clue.text: Dine on pork-pie should the unexpected happen!

definitions.text: Dine on pork-pie should the unexpected happen!

parts.words: Dine on pork-pie should the unexpected happen!
parts.note: a pork-pie is also a style of hat: the clue describes the boast of someone certain a thing will not occur

explanation.surface: A promise to eat a pie if something surprising happens.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying you will consume your headgear expresses total confidence that something will not happen.

clue.text: Miscreant led Quentin in a muddle

indicators.note: a muddle is a confused state, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Quentin was led into trouble by a wrongdoer.
explanation.definitionFit: A delinquent is an offender, especially a young one, which a miscreant also is.

clue.text: Hand is in foot

indicators.note: the word 'is' sits inside the abbreviation

explanation.surface: Comparing a hand and a foot.
explanation.definitionFit: A fist is a hand with the fingers closed tight.

clue.text: Woman shooting up is not hopeful

parts.note: Una is a woman's name
spiring means rising up tall like a spire

explanation.surface: A woman injecting drugs has lost hope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shooting up' suggests drug-taking but means rising like a spire.
explanation.definitionFit: To be unaspiring is to lack ambition or hope of advancement.

clue.text: In which one is taught how to act?

definitions.text: In which one is taught how to act?

parts.words: In which one is taught how to act?
parts.note: reads like a lesson in behaviour but means a drama put on by pupils

explanation.surface: A question about where good manners are learned.
explanation.definitionFit: A play staged by pupils is where children learn to perform on stage.

clue.text: Pretty girl or Soviet leader?

definitions.meaning: a girl with auburn or ginger hair, often thought striking
Communists are Reds, so a Soviet chief is jocularly a red chief

explanation.definitionFit: A girl with red hair is so called, and a 'red head' is a Communist chief.

clue.text: Reg and I included different interpretation

indicators.note: the letters are made different by rearrangement

explanation.surface: Reg and I offered our own view of the text.
explanation.definitionFit: A reading is one particular way of understanding a text or situation.

clue.text: Edward, after short march, was given lower rank

indicators.note: Edward comes after the march piece

parts.note: demo is short for demonstration, a protest march
Ted is a pet form of Edward

explanation.surface: Edward, after a brief protest, was busted down a rank.
explanation.definitionFit: To be demoted is to be reduced to a lower rank, a common military and workplace term.

clue.text: Arrested two men shortly

parts.note: Nick is short for Nicholas
Ed is short for Edward

explanation.surface: Two men were soon taken into custody.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang 'nicked' means arrested by the police.
explanation.definitionFit: Nicked is British slang for arrested.

clue.text: A scientist, in novel fashion

parts.note: novel means new
ton is an old word for fashion or style

explanation.surface: A scientist thinking in an original manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Isaac Newton was the English physicist who formulated the laws of motion and gravity.

clue.text: Extremely precarious situation, having been hung over in court

definitions.meaning: a constant looming threat to one's safety

definitions.text: having been hung over in court
definitions.meaning: a blade suspended by a hair above a courtier at the court of Dionysius

explanation.surface: A dangerous predicament in a courtroom, suggesting a hungover lawyer.
explanation.walkthrough: In legend Dionysius of Syracuse hung a sword by a single hair over his courtier at a banquet in his court.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names a constant threat hanging over someone, from the Greek legend of the suspended blade.

clue.text: Tax this revenue away from the sea

definitions.meaning: the ... Revenue was the British tax department
situated in the interior of a country

explanation.walkthrough: The Inland Revenue was the UK government's tax-collecting department until 2005.
explanation.definitionFit: Inland means in the interior away from the coast, and named Britain's tax office.

clue.text: Cloak has been spotted

definitions.meaning: a loose hooded cloak worn with a mask at masquerades
a game tile marked with spots

explanation.definitionFit: A domino is both a masquerade cloak and a spotted gaming tile.

clue.text: Heparin not gently dispensed for organ displacement

indicators.note: drugs are dispensed, here the remaining letters are given out in a new order
the letter for gently is to be taken out of the drug's name

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for softly or gently

explanation.surface: A pharmacist hands out heparin carefully to someone with a medical problem.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing P from HEPARIN leaves HEARIN, which 'dispensed' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A hernia is the protrusion of an organ through the wall that normally contains it.

clue.text: Here's a new vehicle

indicators.note: the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Presenting a newly acquired car.
explanation.definitionFit: A hearse is the vehicle that carries a coffin to a funeral.

clue.text: Start period of retirement

parts.note: retirement suggests leaving work, but here means retiring for the night

explanation.surface: Beginning life as a pensioner.
explanation.definitionFit: To retire for the night is to head off to sleep, which begins the night's rest.

clue.text: Large number in French island are unemployed

indicators.note: the number goes into the French word

parts.note: île is French for island
D is 500 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Many people on a French island are out of work.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle means not working or without employment.

clue.text: Mark needed to protect joint

indicators.note: the outer words protect, that is surround, the joint's letters

explanation.surface: A scar was needed to shield a joint.
explanation.definitionFit: The knee is the joint between thigh and lower leg.

clue.text: Top speaking part

indicators.note: only a part of the word is used

explanation.surface: The best speaking role in a play.
explanation.definitionFit: A peak is the top or summit of something.

clue.text: Disagreement if red fence collapsed

indicators.note: a fence that has fallen down has its pieces in disorder

explanation.surface: A neighbours' quarrel over a fallen red fence.
explanation.definitionFit: A difference, as in a difference of opinion, is a disagreement.

clue.text: Painter had no right to produce a gory mess

indicators.note: a mess is a jumble, so the letters are rearranged
the letter for right is dropped from the words

explanation.surface: An artist without justification produced a bloody scene.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking R from A GORY leaves AGOY, which 'mess' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Francisco Goya was a Spanish painter, known for dark and violent works.

clue.text: Cork area where congestion might occur

definitions.meaning: the narrow top of a bottle, where its stopper sits
a narrow point that holds up traffic or flow

explanation.surface: A traffic jam spot in the Irish city of Cork.
explanation.definitionFit: The neck of a bottle holds the cork, and the term names any narrow point where traffic jams.
